source.text: "Oil prices are rising and the tariffs are being increased across the world. Those are to me, the fundamentals are much more important than the 8:30 a.m CPI," he said. Sri-Kumar's reminded listeners that core PCE has run above 3% and that inflation has failed to meet the Fed's 2% target for five and a half years.

search_record.judgement: No public forecast of a move LARGER than 25bp at this meeting was located. Every named forecaster reached - J.P. Morgan Wealth Management, UBS Wealth Management USA, EY-Parthenon, Nationwide, Goldman Sachs - calls 25bp, not more. The only located argument for 50bp is Komal Sri-Kumar (Sri-Kumar Global Strategies, 24/7 Wall St., 2026-09-12), and it is PRESCRIPTIVE rather than predictive: he argues the Fed SHOULD hike 50bp while stating in the same piece that 'even a 25 basis point move may not happen'. A source that disclaims the outcome is not a public case that the outcome will occur, so under the standing ruling that advocacy is not a forecast it is recorded here rather than written as a thesis. No thesis was constructed from the market's own question, price or structure (v1.12).
